Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 1 - Introduction to Telephony on the Macintosh / Telephone Manager Initialization Reference

Result Codes

This section describes the result codes for the functions discussed in this chapter.
telNoErr
The function completed without error.
telBadCAErr
The call appearance record is invalid or cannot be found.
telBadCodeResource
A required code resource could not be found.
telBadDNErr
The directory number record is invalid or cannot be found.
telBadFeatID
The specified feature identifier is invalid.
telBadHandErr
The specified record handle is invalid.
telBadProcID
Invalid tool ID specified.
telBadSWErr
Software is not installed properly.
telBadTermErr
The telephone record handle is not valid.
telDeviceNotFound
Cannot find the device needed by a telephone tool.
telInitFailed
Cannot initialize the Telephone Manager.
telNoComm
Cannot find the Extensions folder.
telNoCommFolder
Cannot find the Extensions folder.
telNotEnoughdspBW
Not enough real-time processing available.
telNoMemErr
Not enough memory is available.
telNoSuchTool
Unable to find tool with specified name.
telNoTools
Cannot find any telephone tools in the Extensions folder.
telUnknownErr
The configuration fields could not be determined.
telValidateFailed
Could not validate record.
